question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Extarnal**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given words the incorrectly spelt word is '**Extarnal**'. • Its correct spelling is '**External**'. • **External** (बाह्य / बाहरी) - Belonging to, situated on, or relating to the outside or outer part. • *Example sentence: The **external** appearance of the building was very impressive.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Musk** - A strong-smelling reddish-brown substance that is secreted by the male musk deer and is used as a perfume fixative. (एक तेज-सुगंधित लालभूरा पदार्थ जो पुरुष मुश्क हिरण द्वारा उत्पन्न किया जाता है और एक परफ्यूम फिक्सेटिव के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है।) • **Decide** - To make a choice or reach a conclusion after considering all possible options. (निर्णय करना / फैसला करना) • **Angel** - A spiritual being believed to act as an attendant, agent, or messenger of God, conventionally represented in human form with wings and a long robe; (देवदूत) 3b:T9f5, The correct answer is **'warned against'.**
